messages.content: 1800年英格蘭的國王全名是什麼？

function.name: monarch_getMonarchOfYear
function.description: Retrieve the monarch of a specific location during a specified year. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location (e.g., country) whose monarch needs to be found.

year.description: The year to search the monarch.

fullName.description: If true, returns the full name and title of the monarch.

message.reasoning:
The user asks "1800年英格蘭的國王全名是什麼?" They want the full name of England's king in 1800.

We need to use the tool `monarch_getMonarchOfYear` with location="England" or maybe "United Kingdom"? But historically it's Great Britain? In 1800, King George III was on throne. Full name: His Majesty George William Frederick Ernest Augustus Albert Christian Victor Emmanuel Henry Edward John Charles James Robert Louis Philip Joseph Francis Ferdinand Leopold I. Wait that's too many names; actual full regnal name: George William Frederick Ernest Augustus Albert Christian Victor Emmanuel Henry Edward John Charles James Robert Louis Philip Joseph Francis Ferdinand Leopold I. That seems like an extended list used sometimes but official might just be George William Frederick Ernest Augustus Albert Christian Victor Emmanuel Henry Edward John Charles James Robert Louis Philip Joseph Francis Ferdinand Leopold I. However typical answer: George William Frederick Ernest Augustus Albert Christian Victor Emmanuel Henry Edward John Charles James Robert Louis Philip Joseph Francis Ferdinand Leopold I. Or simply "George William Frederick Ernest Augustus Albert Christian Victor Emmanuel Henry Edward John Charles James Robert Louis Philip Joseph Francis Ferdinand Leopold I". Might also mention he reigned as George III from 1760 until his death in 1820.

Thus we should call the function.
